candidates.video_title: Sun Just Entered Sagittarius — Feel the Shift
candidates.video_description: The Sun moved into Sagittarius at 0.4°, closing out intense Scorpio season energy. Here's what this sign change actually means for the sky right now.
candidates.script: Scorpio season is over — and the sky just exhaled. The Sun is now at zero degrees Sagittarius, the very first breath of fire season, and after weeks of Scorpio's psychological depth, this shift is not subtle. Sagittarius wants expansion, truth, and forward motion. But here's the tension — Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all still retrograde. So the urge to move fast crashes directly into unfinished structure. Which sign are you?

candidates.topic: Waxing Gibbous Moon in Taurus — Pleasure vs Pressure
candidates.teaser: The Moon is almost full — and it's sitting in one of the most stubborn signs in the zodiac right now.
candidates.video_title: Waxing Gibbous Moon in Taurus — Almost Full
candidates.video_description: The Moon is in Taurus and building toward full. In astrology, Taurus Moon energy amplifies comfort-seeking and resistance to change — right as three planets remain retrograde.
candidates.script: The Moon is almost full — and it's locked in Taurus right now. In astrology, Taurus Moon energy is slow, sensory, and deeply resistant to change. It wants comfort, stability, and to hold on. But with Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune all retrograde, the pressure to revisit and rebuild isn't going anywhere. This Moon isn't letting you rush. It's asking what you're actually willing to keep — and what you've been protecting out of fear. What's yours?

candidates.topic: Saturn Retrograde in Aries conjunct Neptune Retrograde — Reality Check
candidates.teaser: Two slow-moving planets are sitting almost on top of each other in Aries right now — and both are moving backward.
candidates.video_title: Saturn and Neptune Retrograde Together in Aries
candidates.video_description: Saturn sits at 8° Aries retrograde, Neptune at 1° Aries retrograde. Astrologers interpret this rare overlap as a collision between reality and illusion — moving backward at the same time.
candidates.script: Saturn and Neptune are both retrograde in Aries right now — and that combination is not casual. Saturn at eight degrees, Neptune at one degree, both moving backward through the sign of identity and new beginnings. In astrology, Saturn represents structure and reality. Neptune rules illusion and dreams. When they both reverse in the same sign, traditional interpretation says the line between what's real and what you're telling yourself gets dangerously thin. Which version of your life are you actually living?

candidates.topic: Mars at 28° Leo — Critical Degree Energy
candidates.teaser: Mars is sitting at one of the most volatile degrees in the zodiac right now — and most people have no idea what that means.
candidates.video_title: Mars at 28° Leo — Critical Degree Explained
candidates.video_description: Mars is at 28° Leo, what astrologers call a critical degree. This placement is interpreted as heightened, urgent energy in Leo themes: ego, performance, recognition, and bold action.
candidates.script: Mars is at twenty-eight degrees Leo right now — and in astrology, that degree isn't ordinary. Critical degrees carry intensified, almost pressurized energy. Leo rules ego, recognition, and the need to be seen. Mars is drive, aggression, and action. At twenty-eight degrees, traditional astrology says this energy is at a peak before it transforms completely. If you've been holding back a bold move or suppressing your ambition, the sky is saying something loud right now.

candidates.topic: Uranus in Gemini — What This Transit Actually Rewires
candidates.teaser: Uranus just moved into Gemini for the first time in over 80 years — and it's doing something most astrology content completely skips over.
candidates.video_title: Uranus in Gemini — What It's Actually Rewiring
candidates.video_description: Uranus in Gemini is a rare, decades-long transit. In astrology, Gemini rules communication, information, and the mind. Uranus rules disruption and sudden change — the combination is interpreted as a revolution in how humanity thinks and speaks.
candidates.script: Uranus hasn't been in Gemini in over eighty years — and right now it's there, retrograde, at three degrees. In astrology, Gemini rules information, language, and the nervous system. Uranus rules disruption, revolution, and the unexpected. Traditional interpretation says this combination rewires how entire generations communicate and process reality. It's not just personal. It's collective. The last time this happened, broadcasting changed the world. So what gets rewired this time?
